publicationReview.note: CBG states that a scan of the front of a card is publicly visible only if all persons named on that card have died; backs are not shown publicly. The repository files must be checked against the publicly available CBG catalogue records. A scan obtained via a personal exemption must not be republished publicly without separate permission.
